purpose: Validate a fixed 28-workload aggregate with unknown coverage preserved and confirmation re-audited from raw evidence
estimator: For each frozen winner use exp((log(first-session geometric candidate/default ratio)+log(second-session geometric candidate/default ratio))/2); never choose the better session
workload_weighting: Equal weight across all 28 workloads; arithmetic mean latency reduction and geometric mean speedup are distinct metrics
screen_coverage: At least one completed non-identity candidate; identity-only is not explored nondefault space
unknowns: Missing or unconfirmed measurements remain explicit; do not average only winners and label it a matrix average
fallback: Separate deployment policy estimate uses a candidate only when both sessions pass the practical criterion, otherwise validated original default; unknown default prevents a complete-matrix aggregate
limitations: confirmation and fallback selection still have uncertainty
